candidate.title: LAM-HTGTS
candidate.scope: The assigned Illumina schematic of linear amplification-mediated high-throughput genome-wide translocation sequencing (LAM-HTGTS), interpreted using the Hu et al. 2016 protocol. The route starts with genomic DNA carrying cellular bait-derived repair products, then depicts sonication, linear amplification, bead capture, bridge-adapter ligation, nested PCR, enzyme blocking, tagged PCR and purification to DNA. The left 'Breakage in genome' icon gives biological context; cellular break generation/joining and downstream sequencing/analysis are not separately drawn operations. The illustrated enzyme-blocking route is extracted; it is optional in the primary protocol. There are no depicted alternative workflows. LAM-PCR is an embedded component, not a second target method. The collection page heading and caption identify this same target; associated kit names and the paper's original HTGTS comparison do not add targets.
